summary: AI sector sentiment faces heavy pressure as Nvidia deals with leadership turmoil and governance concerns, while broader tech positioning shifts amidst smart-money liquidations.

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text: BREAKING: Nvidia’s board, $NVDA, is reportedly not considering having Jensen Huang back as CEO, per CNBC.
picks.why: Nvidia board confirms Jensen Huang is not returning as CEO, intensifying corporate governance and leadership risk for the primary AI bellwether.

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
BREAKING: Google says “the era of autonomous attacks has arrived.”

Hackers are now using AI to scan software updates, figure out which security flaw each patch fixes and build an attack before companies can install the fix, all without a human involved, according to a new report from the Google Threat Intelligence Group.

“Defending against machine-speed threats at human speed isn’t feasible,” Google said.
picks.why: Google warns that autonomous AI attacks have arrived, raising cybersecurity threats and highlighting the limits of human-speed defense.

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
Leopold Aschnbrenner's fund, Situational Awareness, sold nearly its entire stock portfolio and went from $20.24B at the end of June to about $1.58B at the end of September after closing its positions.

This represents a 92% drop.

Ouch. https://t.co/yO8tlWUiBh
picks.why: Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund slashed its stock portfolio by 92% in Q3, signaling aggressive de-risking by prominent tech-focused smart money.
picks.watch: Tech sector, growth stocks, hedge fund positioning

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
Gas prices are falling in all 50 states.

The national average for regular gas is $3.84 a gallon, down 19 cents in a week and nearly 50 cents in a month, per AAA. 

Every state’s average dropped over the past week.
picks.why: US gas prices are falling nationwide for consecutive weeks, offering a strong tailwind for consumer discretionary spending and inflation relief.
picks.watch: Oil commodities, consumer discretionary, retail sector

picks.name: Unusual Whales
picks.text:
Goldman Sachs’ trading desk says confidence in AI is fading.

“Judging by conversations with clients last week, sentiment around the theme is about as negative as we’ve seen in quite some time, and we’re seeing that pessimism reflected more clearly in positioning and valuations.”

Goldman’s chart shows AI chip stocks are now priced for negative earnings growth in two years, far below Wall Street’s consensus forecasts of about 30%.
picks.why: Goldman Sachs notes that AI sentiment is near multi-year lows with chip stocks priced for negative earnings growth.
picks.watch: AI chip stocks, semiconductor sector, market sentiment

picks.name: Michael Burry
picks.text: in late 2025 (Q3 of FY2026), NVIDIA moved from counting revenue by billing or invoicing location to counting revenue by headquarters (HQ) location, a much less geographically informative methodology
picks.why: Michael Burry highlights a shift in Nvidia's revenue accounting methodology toward headquarters-based reporting.
